Rayatron Inc. is a Canadian engineering company headquartered in Kitchener, Ontario, specializing in the design and integration of custom
embedded electronic systems, FPGA-based digital signal processing, and RF/antenna solutions for demanding applications. The company offers
end-to-end hardware and firmware development across nine technical domains: digital hardware design, firmware and embedded software, FPGA design
and IP development, DSP and communications systems, RF circuit design, radar and remote sensing, edge AI, mechanical packaging, and system
architecture. Rayatron's engineering approach is grounded in system-level integration ownership, managing cross-domain interfaces and
dependencies between hardware, firmware, RF, FPGA, and mechanical subsystems through a structured Define–Build–Verify workflow, and delivering
systems validated against defined requirements with full documentation and traceability. The company has particular expertise in RF and
mixed-signal electronics, radar signal processing, remote sensing solutions, and rugged embedded compute for harsh environments, serving
aerospace, space, radar/sensing, industrial, and energy sectors.

Through a community-driven voting system, stakeholders can donate platform tokens to support initiatives, stake funds, or lock capital into projects using smart contracts, ensuring a transparent and structured decision-making process.

By integrating financial participation with the monetization of biodiversity and carbon sequestration, Hyphorest transforms environmental restoration into a tangible and measurable asset class.

entityDescription:
SKYA Oy | Binabik.ai is a deep-tech start-up focusing on embedded and agentic AI for physical robot manipulation with multi-robot systems. The platform enables real-world autonomy, proactive memory, and adaptive behaviors across heterogeneous robot fleets—including UAVs, UGVs, and humanoid agents—for tasks like logistics, inspection, and collaborative manipulation also in space and in-orbit assembly, maintenance, and repair works.​
Leveraging Binabik.ai's opinionated toolkit, SKYA delivers low-latency runtime, fleet orchestration, and human-in-the-loop operations compatible with custom sensors and ROS 2 environments. This supports precise physical interactions, such as payload handovers for aerial robots for scalable aerial data collection contributing the the Earth Observation ecosystem and services with high-precision and on-demand data. Moreover, the solutions enable dynamic robots mission planning in industrial, civil protection, and defence scenarios.​
Key capabilities include:
- Agentic physical AI: Robots that observe, remember context (e.g., object locations), and execute parallel tasks like patrolling, scanning, and conversing while adapting to changes.​

- Multi-robot collaboration: UWB-secured communication for swarms, enabling humanoid integration alongside aerial and ground units for safe human-aware operations.​

- Embedded edge processing: Groq inference with async tool calls for real-time docking, virtual landing zones, and secure DLT integration in multi-agent systems.​

Originating from academic roots in UWB, secure embedded and agentic AI systems, and urban informatics, SKYA | Binabik.ai scales affordable, resilient solutions for 24/7 autonomous services

Novation Tech Hu has its registered office in Sárréti Ipari Park 041/12 hrsz Szeghalom. Novation Tech Hu was incorporated in 2011 and is exclusively involved in manufacturing activities.The Company is specialized in producing componentry for the automotive sector. The company counts about 490 employees and is focused on mass production, it operates as a toll manufacturer for Novation Tech S.p.A.
The main activity of Novation Tech Hu is the production of carbon fibre composite components for Novation Tech S.p.A.Novation Tech is specialized in moulding components in carbon and composite materials. Its drive for continuous improvement and innovation, typical of the competitive sports world, combined with the industrial know-how of the area in which it is located, are the pillars of Novation Tech's business model. Today, in fact, it is one of the leading companies in Europe specializing in high-tech carbon composites and employs more than 1.400 people.Group ProductsNovation Tech Group was originally established as a manufacturer of metal parts, over the years Novation Tech expanded its scope to include plastic injection and the processing of special alloys and today is a leader throughout Europe in the processing and manufacturing of carbon fiber reinforced plastic (CFRP) and composite materials for automotive, aerospace, sports and eyewear parts. Today the core business of the Group is divided into three main sectors, by end-market:•Automotive: automotive is largely the most significant business unit in terms of turnover. From seats to interior parts, structural components and body parts: Novation Tech has developed a number of innovative technologies for the automobile sector to meet both aesthetic and functional needs. Thanks to such technologies, since 2007 it supplies some of the leading car manufacturers.•Sport & Leisure: this is the second segment in term of turnover for the Group, thanks to its patents, which combine plastic and composite materials, Novation Tech is an active part of the constant evolution of the sport lightweight equipment with the aim of maximizing performance, creating products which meet all technical and aesthetic needs: frames, wheels and saddles for bicycles; eyewear; mountaineering equipment.•Aerospace: this is the newest business segment, thanks to its know-how in composite materials, Novation Tech has created and patented a new technology for manufacturing parts for the aerospace industry. The focus of the company is on interiors, leveraging its expertise in seat production with the new patented technology and expanding its customer base.Investments in research as developing processes and innovative production technologies combined with a lean approach to manufacturing, make Novation Tech a leader in the global automobile industry, responding promptly to market demands and delivering finished products of the highest standard. Thanks to its technological knowledge and skills, the company is able to help the clients identify its needs, working together to choose the most suitable materials and technologies that will give the desired outcome, in terms of mechanics, aesthetics, time and costs.

IANUS Technologies is a Cyprus-based research and technology company specializing in cybersecurity, crisis management, civil protection, and digital innovation. The company develops advanced software solutions and platforms that support public authorities, law enforcement agencies, first responders, municipalities, and critical infrastructure operators in addressing complex security and resilience challenges.
IANUS Technologies has extensive experience in European-funded research and innovation projects, particularly under Horizon Europe, EDF and other security-related programmes. Its expertise spans areas such as cyber threat intelligence, vulnerability assessment, situational awareness, decision-support systems, geospatial analytics, and secure information sharing.

Among its key innovations is SERVE, an advanced platform and methodology designed to assess vulnerabilities and security risks in public spaces, critical infrastructures, and large-scale events. SERVE combines geospatial analysis, threat attractiveness modelling, environmental parameters, and operational risk indicators to support evidence-based decision-making and improve preparedness and resilience. The solution enables authorities and security planners to identify weaknesses, evaluate potential impacts, and strengthen preventive and response measures through a structured and adaptable assessment framework.
IANUS is also the developer of MAESTRO, an integrated crisis management and situational awareness platform designed to support emergency response coordination and operational collaboration. MAESTRO provides real-time information sharing, incident monitoring, communication, and decision-support capabilities for first responders, law enforcement agencies, civil protection authorities, and crisis managers. The platform incorporates advanced technologies such as geospatial intelligence, secure communications, and mobile support tools to enhance coordination and response efficiency during emergencies and security incidents.

Institut cirkulární ekonomiky (INCIEN) is a Czech non-governmental non-profit organisation focusing on the topic of circular economy since 2015. INCIEN supports the transition towards sustainable resource use through:
- Analytical work related to the circular economy policy framework and business models
- National/regional project collaboration in the associated topics: circular construction, low-carbon materials, circular bioeconomy, agrifood value chain.
- Project management as a project partner (including stakeholder engagement, public speaking, event organisation, presentation skills)
- Developing voluntary sectoral agreements based on our experience with the Partnership For model, inspired by Dutch Green Deals.
- Field services including waste analysis, coordination of pilot projects etc.
- National communication and marketing campaigns, including educational content, multimedia and sharing of best practice.
The work of INCIEN connects expert knowledge, data and practical implementation, helping companies, public institutions, municipalities and other stakeholders identify circular opportunities, meet legislative requirements and develop strategies with real impact.

SENSORES E INSTRUMENTACION GUEMISA S.L. (GUEMISA) is a Spanish company specialized in industrial sensors, measurement systems, instrumentation and data acquisition solutions.

Founded in 1985, GUEMISA provides technical support, distribution and integration of advanced sensing technologies for industrial automation, aerospace, energy, infrastructure monitoring, transportation, environmental monitoring and research applications.

Our portfolio includes:

• Position sensors (LVDT, potentiometric, magnetostrictive and laser sensors)
• Rotary encoders and angular position measurement systems
• Pressure, temperature, humidity and environmental sensors
• Inclinometers and inertial measurement devices (IMU)
• Force, load and torque measurement systems
• Data acquisition and signal conditioning equipment
• Industrial communication interfaces and monitoring systems
• Structural health monitoring instrumentation
• Calibration and measurement solutions

GUEMISA collaborates with leading European manufacturers and technology partners, providing customized solutions from prototype development to industrial deployment.

The company supports customers in Spain, Portugal and international markets through technical consultancy, engineering support, system integration and after-sales service.

We are interested in participating in ESA-related projects as:

• Supplier of sensors and instrumentation
• Technical partner for measurement and monitoring systems
• Consortium member for industrial and R&D projects
• Technology provider for data acquisition and sensing applications

Core competencies include precision measurement, industrial sensing technologies, environmental monitoring, signal processing and instrumentation engineering.

entityDescription:
Montr develops innovative IoT-based safety solutions designed to protect employees and lone workers in situations where immediate assistance may be required. The Montr IoT Emergency Button enables users to trigger an alarm with a single press, providing rapid notification and location information to designated responders, monitoring centres, or integrated third-party platforms.
The solution combines advanced communication technologies such as LTE-M, NB-IoT, GNSS positioning, and Wi-Fi-based indoor localisation with a secure cloud platform to ensure reliable and timely alarm delivery. Montr serves organisations across healthcare, local government, housing associations, facility management, security services, and other sectors where employee safety is a critical concern.
Based in the Netherlands, Montr develops both the hardware and software components of its solutions in-house, allowing for rapid innovation and close alignment with customer requirements. Recent developments include indoor positioning using Wi-Fi fingerprinting and the integration of Non-Terrestrial Network (NTN) capabilities to provide satellite-based connectivity in areas where terrestrial mobile coverage is unavailable. Through these innovations, Montr is building the next generation of resilient personal safety solutions that remain connected whenever and wherever help is needed.

entityDescription:
OpenGeoHub is a research foundation with headquarters in Wageningen, the Netherlands (Stichting OpenGeoHub, KvK 71844570). The main goal of the OpenGeoHub is to promote publishing and sharing of Open Geographical and Geoscientific Data and using and developing Open Source Software. 
OpenGeoHub foundation provides three types of services:
- Data production: We promote and actively support the production, sharing and use of Open GeoData (based on the Open Knowledge Foundation licenses). We provide platforms, tools, standards and training to encourage and support Open Geodata and reproducible research shared using open web services and open standards.
- Training and workshops: We help researchers grow by connecting them with peer networks, helping them improve their programming skills, and helping them to make their research more open and reproducible. We aim especially to encourage and empower under-represented researchers (e.g. those from ODA recipient countries and female researchers). We are a certified higher education organization registered under the Dutch Centraal Register Kort Beroeps Onderwijs (CRKBO).

- Serving decision makers: We aim to provide all users (governmental and non-governmental organizations, private sector companies and the general public) with easily accessible and trustworthy Open Geographical Environmental Data, fully documented, peer reviewed and reproducible.

description: Caribou ESG Toolbox is ESG software provider. Integrated stakeholder engagement: Our software provides integrated tools to efficiently engage key stakeholders—including employees, suppliers, customers, investors, and communities. Through surveys, dialogue management, and feedback tracking, the platform ensures transparent documentation, strengthens the credibility of sustainability reporting, and helps align corporate strategy with stakeholder expectations.; 2. Expert guidance - Caribou is built by sustainability experts and guides you step by step through the CSRD/ESRS compliance process. The platform embeds best-practice workflows, expert recommendations, and pre-configured templates aligned with ESRS disclosure requirements to support double materiality assessments, gap analysis, and data collection. With clear explanations for complex topics, Caribou simplifies standard navigation, reduces reliance on external consultants, and enables accurate, efficient preparation of your sustainability statement; 3. ?Legal questions on CSRD - Our software helps companies confidently address CSRD-related legal questions, including scope and applicability, phase-in provisions, thresholds, and assurance requirements. With embedded references to the EFRAG implementation guidance, and curated FAQs, the platform enables quick interpretation of regulatory obligations, supports audit-ready documentation, and helps users stay aligned with the evolving legal framework for sustainability reporting.
